schema_documentation:
**Two mutually exclusive key-sets, 11 keys each — `text` and `section` never co-occur.** Measured on 25,392 parsed records (stats json agrees on 24,928).

Set A — 21,583/25,392 = **85.0%**: `id`, `row_id`, `filename`, `has_table`, `has_list`, `header`, `place`, `predicted_section`, `diplomatiki`, `titlos`, **`text`**.
Set B — 3,809/25,392 = **15.0%**: the same 10 keys but **`section` instead of `text`**.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | int | 100% | row index |
| `row_id` | str | 100% | `row_<id>` — fully redundant with `id` |
| `filename` | str | 100% | source thesis id, `paper_10`; **~81 sections per thesis** (312 distinct filenames in 25,392 records) |
| `header` | str | 100% | section heading; min 1 / p50 28 / mean 36 / max 808 ch |
| `place` | str, 9 ch | 100% | positional range in the document, `0.88-0.90` |
| `has_table` | 0/1 | 100% | 2,875/25,392 = 11.3% |
| `has_list` | 0/1 | 100% | 4,874/25,392 = 19.2% |
| `predicted_section` | str | 100% | κ 20,050 (78.9%), ε.σ. 1,799 (7.1%), β 1,558 (6.1%), α 780 (3.1%), άλλο 643 (2.5%), π 562 (2.2%) |
| `diplomatiki` | str | 100% | 3 values; README full-file: ΜΔΕ 813,016 (64.4%) / Διδακτορικές 331,484 (26.2%) / Πτυχιακές 118,834 (9.4%) |
| `titlos` | str | 100% | thesis title, repeated identically on all ~81 sections of a thesis; p50 106 ch |
| `text` | str | **85.0%** | section body — the only training content |
| `section` | str | 15.0% | **ALWAYS the empty string `''`** — 3,809/3,809 in my sample, and the stats json enum for it is `['']` over 3,895 records. It is NOT a ground-truth label. |
semantic_meaning: University of Athens (Pergamos repository) theses split into ~81 labelled sections each — short passages, not whole documents.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
